card.summary: The full FLUX.2 [dev] flagship (Q4_K_M on 24 GB). Best-in-family prompt understanding, typography and photorealism; the large sibling of the Klein models. Encoder and model load sequentially, so each fits 24 GB separately.
card.pick_when: You want the highest FLUX.2 quality on a 24 GB card and non-commercial is OK.

prompt.guidance: LLM-style prose (Mistral encoder); front-load the key subject. Distilled guidance ~4, no negative.
prompt.example: A weathered lighthouse on a storm-lashed cliff at dusk, beam cutting through rain, huge crashing waves, dramatic volumetric light, photorealistic, 35mm
prompt.instructions: Structure as Subject + Action + Style + Context; word order matters (most important first). Specify lighting. Quote literal text for typography and tie colors to objects with hex codes. FLUX.2 does not use negative prompts: guidance ~4, cfg 1, ~20 steps.
do: Quote text and give its style/placement/hex color
prompt.negative_guidance: FLUX.2 does not support negative prompts — describe what you want.

speed.measured_note: ~32B Q4_K_M on 24 GB (sequential encoder/model swap); not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want like you'd tell ChatGPT — more detail looks better. The top-quality model here.
